verdict.rationale: Ultrametric has versioning-adjacent features: you can pin a specific process version, records carry revisions with retrievable history, `init --dry-run` previews skill-file changes before writing, and skill files can be committed to source control for team review. But the processes are vendor-managed guides rather than user-authored automations, and nothing documents rolling back a run, record, or process to an earlier state. Missing for 10: rollback/restore capability, versioning of user-defined automations, a review/approval workflow for changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of revision history.
